targets.rawSql: SELECT 0 as id, 'All Locations' as name, 0 as level, NULL::integer as parent_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM org_units) UNION ALL SELECT id, name, level, COALESCE(parent_id, 0) as parent_id FROM org_units UNION ALL SELECT NULL, 'No data', NULL, NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM org_units) ORDER BY parent_id NULLS FIRST, name

-- Place, month and coverage for the line above the table.
SELECT
  flags."isAllowed",
  flags.place,
  flags.month_label,
  cov.coverage
FROM (
  SELECT '${isAllowed}'::text AS "isAllowed",
         COALESCE((SELECT o.name FROM heart360tk_schema.org_units o
                   WHERE o.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')),
                  'All locations') AS place,
         to_char(NULLIF('${reporting_month}', '')::date, 'FMMon-YYYY') AS month_label
) flags
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN NULL
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT reporting_n) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cohort_n) = 1
        THEN MIN(reporting_n)::text || ' of ' || MIN(cohort_n)::text || ' facilities reported'
      ELSE string_agg(
        drug_category || ' ' || reporting_n::text || ' of ' || cohort_n::text || ' facilities',
        ' · ' ORDER BY CASE drug_category
          WHEN 'CCB' THEN 1 WHEN 'ARB' THEN 2 WHEN 'Diuretic' THEN 3 ELSE 4
        END, drug_category
      ) || ' reported'
    END AS coverage
    FROM heart360tk_reporting.drug_stock_patient_days_all(
      NULLIF('${reporting_month}', '')::date,
      NULLIF('${org_unit}', '')::integer
    )
  ) AS master_access_control
  WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'
    AND coverage IS NOT NULL
) cov ON true

-- The user's home unit, the same query as heart360.home.json UserOrgUnitId (UX-02).
WITH me AS (
  SELECT u.id, u.is_admin FROM "user" u WHERE u.id = ${__user.id}
),
my_teams AS (
  SELECT t.name
  FROM me
  JOIN team_member tm ON tm.user_id = me.id
  JOIN team t ON tm.team_id = t.id
  WHERE NOT me.is_admin
),
specific_units AS (
  SELECT hc.level, ou.id, ou.name
  FROM my_teams mt
  JOIN heart360tk_schema.hierarchy_config hc
    ON mt.name ~ ('^heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_(patients|aggregated)_')
    AND mt.name NOT LIKE '%\_ALL' ESCAPE '\'
  JOIN heart360tk_schema.org_units ou
    ON ou.level = hc.level
    AND regexp_replace(lower(trim(ou.name)), '\s+', '_', 'g') =
        regexp_replace(mt.name, '^heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_(patients|aggregated)_', '')
),
all_access_level AS (
  SELECT MIN(hc.level) AS level
  FROM my_teams mt
  JOIN heart360tk_schema.hierarchy_config hc
    ON mt.name IN ('heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_patients_ALL',
                   'heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_aggregated_ALL')
),
all_access_units AS (
  SELECT ou.level, ou.id, ou.name
  FROM all_access_level al
  JOIN heart360tk_schema.org_units ou ON ou.level = al.level
  WHERE al.level > 1
),
candidates AS (
  SELECT * FROM specific_units
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM all_access_units
)
SELECT COALESCE(
  (SELECT id::text FROM candidates ORDER BY level ASC, name ASC LIMIT 1),
  ''
) AS home_unit

panels.description: Days of medicine left for the registered patients, by medicine group. Red under 30 days, orange 30 to 59, yellow 60 to 89, green 90 or more. ? means the facility has not reported stock for this month. Open Tablets in stock below for the counts.

targets.rawSql:
-- Patient days only, like the established stock report (UX-32). Tablet counts are in the
-- Tablets in stock row. Registered patients is the patient-days denominator.
-- Empty text must stay null. A cast of '' fails while Postgres plans the query.
SELECT * FROM (
WITH m AS (
  SELECT f.matrix, f.ord
  FROM heart360tk_reporting.drug_stock_on_hand_matrix(
    NULLIF('${reporting_month}', '')::date,
    NULLIF('${org_unit}', '')::integer
  ) WITH ORDINALITY AS f(matrix, ord)
),
pts AS (
  SELECT v.facility_name, MAX(v.patients_n) AS patients_n
  FROM heart360tk_reporting.drug_stock_patient_days v
  WHERE v.reporting_month = NULLIF('${reporting_month}', '')::date
    AND v.org_unit_id IN (SELECT g.id FROM heart360tk_schema.get_descendant_ids(NULLIF('${org_unit}', '')::integer) g)
  GROUP BY v.facility_name
)
SELECT (
  SELECT json_object_agg(c.k, c.v ORDER BY c.n)
  FROM (
    SELECT 'Facility' AS k, m.matrix -> 'Facility' AS v, 0::bigint AS n
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Registered patients',
           to_json(CASE WHEN m.matrix ->> 'Facility' = 'All'
                        THEN (SELECT SUM(p.patients_n) FROM pts p)
                        ELSE (SELECT p.patients_n FROM pts p WHERE p.facility_name = m.matrix ->> 'Facility') END),
           1
    UNION ALL
    -- Whole days, rounded here so the colour matches the number shown (89.9998 is 90, green).
    SELECT e.key,
           CASE WHEN json_typeof(e.value) = 'number' THEN to_json(ROUND((e.value #>> '{}')::numeric))
                ELSE e.value END,
           1 + e.n
    FROM json_each(m.matrix) WITH ORDINALITY AS e(key, value, n)
    WHERE e.key LIKE '% Patient days'
  ) c
) AS matrix
FROM m
ORDER BY m.ord
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

panels.title: Stock on hand

panels.description: Type the stock of each protocol medicine for one facility. Above facility level, choose the facility first. Blank means not counted; 0 means none in stock. The month starts on this month.

targets.rawSql:
-- Enter stock form (story 3.5, UX-13). Every row carries the flags; the data rows are one per
-- stock-form facility inside the selected place, protocol drug and strength, and month (this
-- month and the five before). A district user picks the facility in the form. Saving goes to
-- h360-api, which checks access again; this datasource is read-only.
SELECT flags.*, d.* FROM (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF('${isAllowed}', ''), '0')::int AS "isAllowed",
    CASE WHEN NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "isAll",
    to_char(date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS this_month,
    -- Names the board month so a change of Reporting Month after a save re-runs this query.
    '${reporting_month}'::text AS board_month
) flags LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT
      f.id AS facility_id,
      f.name AS facility_name,
      dr.rxnorm_code AS drug_code,
      dr.drug_name,
      dr.drug_name || ' ' || dr.dosage AS drug_label,
      to_char(m.month_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS month,
      to_char(m.month_start, 'FMMon-YYYY')
        || CASE WHEN m.month_start = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) THEN ' (this month)' ELSE '' END AS month_label,
      s.in_stock,
      to_char(s.submitted_at, 'DD-Mon-YYYY') AS saved_on,
      to_char(s.submitted_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS saved_at,
      s.submitted_by AS saved_by,
      CASE dr.drug_category WHEN 'CCB' THEN 1 WHEN 'ARB' THEN 2 WHEN 'Diuretic' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS cat_ord,
      COALESCE(substring(dr.dosage FROM '^[0-9]+[.]?[0-9]*')::numeric, 0) AS dose_ord
    FROM heart360tk_schema.drug_stock_form_cohort c
    JOIN heart360tk_schema.org_units f
      ON f.id = c.org_unit_id
     AND f.level = COALESCE((SELECT hc.level FROM heart360tk_schema.hierarchy_config hc WHERE hc.var_name = 'facility'), 3)
    CROSS JOIN heart360tk_schema.active_stock_tracked_drugs dr
    CROSS JOIN generate_series(
      date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date - interval '5 months',
      date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date,
      interval '1 month'
    ) AS m(month_start)
    LEFT JOIN heart360tk_schema.drug_stock_submission s
      ON s.org_unit_id = f.id
     AND s.reporting_month = m.month_start::date
     AND s.rxnorm_code = dr.rxnorm_code
     AND s.country_code = dr.country_code
     AND s.programme_code = dr.programme_code
    WHERE f.id IN (
      SELECT g.id FROM heart360tk_schema.get_descendant_ids(
        CASE WHEN TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}') ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}')::int END
      ) g
    )
  ) AS master_access_control
  WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'
) d ON true
ORDER BY d.facility_name NULLS FIRST, d.month DESC, d.cat_ord, d.drug_name, d.dose_ord

panels.description: Tablets counted for each medicine and strength. ? means not reported; — means not counted.

targets.rawSql:
-- Tablet counts per medicine and strength (UX-32: kept out of the main table), with thousands
-- commas. Empty text must stay null. A cast of '' fails while Postgres plans the query.
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT (
  SELECT json_object_agg(
    e.key,
    CASE WHEN json_typeof(e.value) = 'string' AND (e.value #>> '{}') ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
         THEN to_json(to_char(ROUND((e.value #>> '{}')::numeric), 'FM999,999,999,990'))
         ELSE e.value END
    ORDER BY e.n)
  FROM json_each(f.matrix) WITH ORDINALITY AS e(key, value, n)
  WHERE e.key NOT LIKE '% Patient days'
) AS matrix
FROM heart360tk_reporting.drug_stock_on_hand_matrix(
  NULLIF('${reporting_month}', '')::date,
  NULLIF('${org_unit}', '')::integer
) WITH ORDINALITY AS f(matrix, ord)
ORDER BY f.ord
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

list.definition:
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(1), 0) AS is_allowed
FROM grafana_schema.user u
LEFT OUTER JOIN grafana_schema.team_member tm ON tm.user_id = u.id
LEFT OUTER JOIN grafana_schema.team t ON tm.team_id = t.id
WHERE u.id = ${__user.id}
  AND (
      u.is_admin = true
      OR (
          NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM heart360tk_schema.hierarchy_config hc
              WHERE t.name IN (
                  'heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_aggregated_ALL',
                  'heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_patients_ALL'
              )
          )
      )
      OR (
          NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NOT NULL
          AND (
              t.name IN (
                  SELECT (SELECT group_name FROM heart360tk_schema.get_access_groups(lin.ancestor_id, 'aggregated') LIMIT 1)
                  FROM heart360tk_schema.org_unit_lineage lin
                  WHERE lin.org_unit_id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int
                  UNION
                  SELECT (SELECT group_name FROM heart360tk_schema.get_access_groups(lin.ancestor_id, 'patients') LIMIT 1)
                  FROM heart360tk_schema.org_unit_lineage lin
                  WHERE lin.org_unit_id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int
              )
              OR EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM heart360tk_schema.hierarchy_config hc
                  WHERE t.name IN (
                      'heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_aggregated_ALL',
                      'heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_patients_ALL'
                  )
                    AND hc.level <= (
                      SELECT level FROM heart360tk_schema.org_units
                      WHERE id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int
                      LIMIT 1
                    )
              )
          )
      )
  )
